  struct Pair<A, B>
    field first: A
    field second: B
  class Box<A, B>(val first: A, val second: B)
  enum Choice<A, B>
    Both(A, B)
  class Factory()
    fun create
  fun pair<A, B>(first: A, second: B): Pair<A, B>
    =
      Call Pair
        Var first
        Var second
  fun A.attach<A, B>(second: B): Pair<A, B>
    =
      Call Pair
        This
        Var second
  fun apply<A, B>(value: A, operation: (A) -> B): B
    =
      Call operation
        Var value
  fun describe(value: Int): String
    =
      MethodCall toString
        Var value
  fun nested<A, B>(value: Pair<A, B>): B
    =
      FieldAccess second
        Var value
  fun gather<A, B>(value: A, fallback: B, label: B = <expr>, vararg rest: B): B
    =
      Var label

    =
      MethodCall toString
        Var second
  fun overload<A, B>(first: A, second: B): String
    =
      StringLiteral "generic"

    =
      StringLiteral "int"
